name: USCW Television Title
epitaph: Changed hands twice in three months during the fed's own busiest 1998 stretch, first in the fed's inaugural Weapons and Cage match and then by submission at Midweek Madness.

name: USCW Tag Team Title
epitaph: Won at Battle Bowl '98 by a team whose own second member never set foot in the ring for the title match.

name: USCW Light Heavyweight Title
epitaph: Changed hands in a three-way match settled by a run-in blow rather than a fall between the two wrestlers left standing.

name: USCW Heavyweight Title
epitaph: Crowned at Battle Bowl '98 in a tournament final decided by a stablemate's interference, its new champion ambushed by an old rival within the hour.

name: USCW North American Title
epitaph: Ended an undefeated champion's own six-match streak at Midweek Madness.
